3) Accessibility-centric detail handling:
   - All lookups use page.get_by_role and .nth() only after awaiting .count() to avoid indexing errors.

The instructions require using helpers when appropriate; I evaluated the helper and determined it would not be appropriate in this run because it would undo the current state and fail. Therefore I implemented the search flow directly using accessibility role selectors.

5) Final action:
   - The script clicks the bottom result (link inside the last article or the article itself). That click is the last action performed by act() because it typically causes navigation away from the current page.

Utility of the knowledge-base functions for this task:
   - create_curated_collection_by_search: Very useful when starting from the site root and when the complementary region exists on '/'. Not useful in this particular session because it always navigates to '/' which does not expose the search region here.
   - create_curated_collection_and_newsletter: A wrapper around the above helper; similarly not useful for the same reason.
